All requested features verified: Login with email/password working, RecipeBuilder modal has all 4 tabs (Basic, Costing, Details, Packaging), Details tab shows Allergens checkboxes (14 allergens), PlatedMenuBuilder shows all pricing fields (Buffer %, Default Guest Count, Target Margin %, Sell Price per Guest) and pricing dashboard (Cost per Guest, With Buffer, Suggested Price, Actual Margin, Profit).
